reviews.review_text:
Karen
5 contributions
0
Terrible service, expensive for the low quality of food you receive...
Dec 2018 • Family
We unfortunately came here for my last meal in Vietnam. I was to go back home earlier than the rest of my family.

First, they gave us (a family of three) one menu. We had to ask for one more. After we told our waitress what we wanted in Vietnamese and had her tell us every item she wrote down, we waited. We ordered two lemon sodas and they gave us lemons with cups of ice in them, no soda. So we had to flag them down and ask for the soda. Then, they gave us our food and as we were eating, we noticed my sister's meal had not arrived. We asked a waiter again where was her meal and they were confused and said it was coming (but clearly they had forgot or never wrote it down or something). So after me and my mom finished eating AND they gave us a meal-to-go that we had asked to only give to us at the end of our meal, my sister finally got her meal. And, we watched three different waiters with her meal try to give it to other tables until realizing it was our table. We tasted the soup and it was straight-up boiled water with some greens in it. I had never laughed at how miserable and bad a dish tasted. The rest of the food was ok, but not worth the price we paid. On top of all this, we noticed they didn't give us any to-go utensils for our to-go meal and asked for some. They told us there were none...how can a restaurant serve to-go food and not provide to-go utensils with it? We are supposed to just bring to-go noodle soup back to the hotel and eat it with our hands? When we asked for the check, we were then told that they don't accept card. So we had to pay in VND. Which isn't a big deal but why state on your website that card is an acceptable form of payment? 

We watched multiple servers/workers run around and play games in the back. There were four other tables being served and more than 10 employees (that we saw) and most of the time, all of these employees were inattentive. 

I used to work in the food service industry and so I try to be as empathetic as possible. But c'mon...this was just unacceptable. I rarely write bad reviews - actually, I have only written one bad review before this and that was in 2014. 

Do not go here unless you want to pay a high price for mediocre food and bad service.

Nice, authentic Vietnamese evening dinner - no frills . just good food and great company!
Sep 2015 • Business
On my last evening my local Vietnamese hosts selected an authentic restaurant close to the airport to say goodbye. I put myself totally into their hands and ate whatever came on to the table. There was a complete range of different goodies – too many to mention but I recall soups, noodles, sticky rice, sweet, honey pork slices, squid and cuttlefish and a complete roasted chicken, chopped up into pieces & served on one large plate. I left the crispy head to my neighbor at our table… 

We had our part of the restaurant to ourselves so that we could make as much noise as we wanted. With 6 ladies and 2 men, this was quite a lot of noise. The little waitress was busy throughout the meal – she coped with all our requests with professional efficiency and the occasional smile. I think that the English speaking men in our group put her off a bit and lead to ultra shyness… 

Drinking from a coconut was a special treat for me – and to top this, the busy waitress took the shell away and scooped out the inner flesh for me to eat separately. 

This was was of those meals where everyone mucks in and grabs a bit of everything that comes. In a totally informal setting and with much laughter and chatter we all had a great time of eating like the real natives. Absolutely superb and a fitting way to end my short but eventful visit to this fascinating city in an equally fascinating country.
